votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No. 4 for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: The Board voted to close the public hearing regarding the resolution to amend the RDA's final budget for FY 2023-24, which included adjustments based on property tax increment and funding for agency operations and Ballpark NEXT.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of April 16, 2024, and May 14, 2024
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from its April and May 2024 sessions.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 8 of 2024 – RDA Budget Amendment No. 4 for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the RDA's final budget for FY 2023-24, including adjustments based on actual property tax increment, interlocal agreements, reimbursement agreements, and additional funding for agency operations and Ballpark NEXT.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 9 of 2024 – Northwest Quadrant Tax Increment Reimbursement Agreement
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution approving a Tax Increment Reimbursement Agreement with NWQ, LLC for infrastructure and property improvements in the Northwest Quadrant Community Reinvestment Area, with a maximum reimbursement of $49,562,855 over 20 years.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 10 of 2024 – Amendment to Housing Development Loan Funding Allocations for The Catherine, with the requirement that Phase I HUD HOME requirements and regulations are met prior to closing
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the Housing Development Loan Program loan to The Catherine (Phase 1 and Phase 2) project at approximately 1881 West North Temple, restructuring it as an acquisition loan with a conditional waiver of the 30-year deed restriction subject to HUD HOME compliance.
